articles.title_en: How Wikipedia’s Editors Keep the Online Encyclopedia Human-Written
articles.summary_en: Ellia Lebleu is a founding member of the WikiProject AI Cleanup , a volunteer effort launched in 2023 to find and remove AI-generated material from Wikipedia that breaks the website’s guidelines. When the cleanup began, AI writing was often betrayed by conspicuous clichés. articles.title_en: Tesla skipped the most important shareholder question on its earnings call
articles.summary_en: Tesla skipped one of its top shareholder questions on its Q3 2026 earnings call: when Hardware 3 owners will find out if they get a free computer upgrade for the unsupervised “Full Self-Driving” they paid for. The question ranked fifth by shares on Say. Tesla read and answered questions ranked below it. It went past this one without a word. more…
